items.title: HSBC reduit son objectif sur Gucci mais conseille toujours d'achat
items.summary: HSBC cut its Kering price target from 305 to 300 euros after a cautious Q3 pre-close call that flagged slower new-product launches, weaker store traffic (partly offset by better conversion) and an unfavorable base effect; Barclays, Citi and Jefferies also trimmed targets the same day, while HSBC still defended Demna's 'quality, creativity, pricing discipline' repositioning.

items.title: Le sneaker Gucci made in China sono un problema politico
items.summary: Opinion piece arguing Gucci's decision to make its new 800-euro Drip sneaker in China is not just a branding issue but exposes a structural weakness in Italian manufacturing; the piece paraphrases Gucci's own justification that Italian suppliers lacked the technical capacity, framed as "l'Italia non e stata all'altezza delle richieste," and calls for industrial policy response.

items.source: Inside Retail Australia (syndicated trade coverage, EU-market subject)
items.title: Why Gucci's 'Made in China' sneakers are raising questions
items.summary: Gucci's Drip sneaker (about 800 euros in Europe, designed by Demna) and a second slip-on model are manufactured in China, breaking with the brand's Italian-heritage positioning; Berenberg analysts warned of tension between provenance and luxury pricing, a Milan consultant called it simply "not a good look," and Barclays flagged risk to the brand's value proposition when paired with recent price cuts.

items.title: Nouveau trou d'air pour Kering apres une conference de fin de trimestre frileuse
items.summary: Kering shares fell on the Paris exchange after the pre-close investor call struck a cautious tone, citing a weaker summer trading period, continued China softness and slowing US/Japan/South Korea momentum heading into Q3 Gucci results.

items.title: Gucci Spring 2027 Ready-to-Wear Collection photos
items.summary: WWD's gallery and coverage of Demna's second Gucci womenswear show, staged as a recreated Gucci boutique ("The Store Show") at Milan's Allianz Mi-Co, moving through riding-habit tailoring, 1990s minimalism and Tom Ford-era silhouettes with the Boston and Lady Lunetta bags and GG monogram belt in heavy rotation.

items.title: Demna's Gucci Is Selling a Dream
items.summary: Review of the SS27 show argues Demna's built-store concept and remixed archive codes (equestrian tailoring, mini skirt suits, logo belts) make an explicit case that Gucci equals aspirational glamour, with Demna quoted that the brand is rooted in "the audacity to remake that world in your own image."

items.title: Recent UK Trustpilot reviews flag service and quality complaints
items.summary: Cluster of recent 1-star UK reviews: one customer said Gucci "could not care a less if your product becomes faulty," another described slides that "deteriorated quickly" with customer service denying a manufacturing defect, and a third criticized a disputed high-value purse return where Gucci claimed the item was missing from the box; a separate reviewer panned the men's Spring 2027 collection as "uninspired and boring."

items.source: theFashionSpot forum (Discussion: The State of Kering)
items.title: Forum members debate Gucci SS27 and Kering's turnaround odds
items.summary: Long-running fan/enthusiast forum thread remains active with mixed-to-skeptical commentary on Demna's direction and whether Kering's debt load and repeated price repositioning will restore Gucci's desirability; posters continue to question management credibility after years of declining sales.
